name: Loop Returns
description: Loop Returns for Claude makes returns management as easy as having a conversation. Connect your existing shop and simply chat to find returns, review line items and timelines, approve or reject requests, add notes for your team, and flag fraud. You can also manage your allowlists and blocklists, check your return policies, and review the workflows driving your automation, all without leaving your assistant.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Loop Returns to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Loop Returns to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.loopreturns.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Loop Returns MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Loop Returns lists 24 MCP tools, including add-return-note-tool, add-to-allowlist-tool, add-to-blocklist-tool, cancel-return-tool, close-return-tool, flag-return-tool, get-return-timeline-tool, get-return-tool, get-shop-info-tool, get-workflow-tool, list-allowlist-tool, and list-blocklist-tool.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Loop Returns?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Loop Returns in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.

_published_faq.name: Does Loop Returns MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Loop Returns requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Loop Returns is developed by Loop Returns. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
